Callout.Name: Chemical Find - Secure It
Callout.Message: Drums found at a disused site, strong smell reported.
Callout.Advisory: No persons present, wind taking it toward the road.

Script.Line: We have not used that part of the site in two years.
The drums are not ours. I can show you the delivery notes.
Do not open them. I am asking you not to open them.

Lines.Approach: Nobody is there and the wind is taking it towards the road. That is the problem.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
